channel.title: Offsetease — Insights
channel.description: Referenced analysis on the rules reshaping climate, carbon and ESG.

item.title: CBAM strategy for iron & steel: what exporters must decide in 2026
item.description: CBAM is now a carbon price at the EU border for steel — the widest scope, the highest emissions. Verified data vs default values, and how to turn it into an edge.

item.title: I-RECs explained: how energy attribute certificates cut your Scope 2 — credibly
item.description: I-RECs let companies claim renewable electricity and cut market-based Scope 2 worldwide. How they work — and what makes a claim hold up.

item.title: Funding the net-zero transition: building a pathway your CFO will actually finance
item.description: The gap between a net-zero pledge and a funded plan is a cost curve, a capital plan and financing. How to build a business case the board approves.

item.title: High-integrity carbon credits: ICVCM, VCMI, and how to avoid the headline risk
item.description: The carbon market has split on integrity — ICVCM defines the credit, VCMI the claim. What separates a quality carbon asset from a liability.

item.title: IFRS S1 and S2 explained: the global baseline for sustainability disclosure
item.description: IFRS S1 and S2 are the global baseline for sustainability and climate disclosure. What they require, who must comply, and how to prepare.

item.title: Scope 3 emissions: why they are most of your footprint and how to actually measure them
item.description: Scope 3 is typically 70–90% of your footprint and the hardest to measure. The 15 categories, the methods that work, and where to start.

item.title: ISCC EU vs ISCC PLUS vs CORSIA: which certification your business needs
item.description: ISCC EU, PLUS, CORSIA and Carbon Footprint serve different markets. How to choose the right certification — or the right combination.

item.title: How EcoVadis scoring really works — and how to move from Bronze to Gold
item.description: EcoVadis scores suppliers on four themes, with medals on a percentile curve. What the score really rewards — and how to move from Bronze to Gold.

item.title: EUDR explained: deforestation-free supply chains, plot-level geolocation, and the deadline
item.description: Seven commodities banned from the EU market unless proven deforestation-free and traceable to the plot. What EUDR demands — and how to prepare.

item.title: LCA, PCF and EPD: which one your buyers are actually asking for
item.description: As carbon requirements move from the company to the product, three acronyms dominate procurement conversations. They are related but not interchangeable — and choosing wrong wastes months.

item.title: BRSR Core explained: India's assured sustainability disclosure and the value-chain ripple
item.description: India's BRSR has moved from narrative to assured data. BRSR Core requires reasonable assurance on a defined set of KPIs — and pushes ESG requirements down to unlisted suppliers.

item.title: CDP after the overhaul: one questionnaire, IFRS-aligned, and how to score well
item.description: CDP consolidated its separate questionnaires into a single, IFRS-aligned disclosure on a new platform. How the system now works, how scoring is decided, and what actually moves your grade.

item.title: SBTi's Corporate Net-Zero Standard V2: what the draft changes — and how to prepare
item.description: The Science Based Targets initiative opened a draft of Version 2 of its Corporate Net-Zero Standard. It is not final — but the direction is clear, and target-setting companies should prepare now.

item.title: CBAM in 2026: the definitive period, the Omnibus simplification, and what exporters must do now
item.description: From 1 January 2026 the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism stops being a reporting exercise and becomes a cost. What changed, who is now exempt, and the moves that protect your margin.
